title: OneLake Catalog search API, MCP, and CLI tools (Preview)

content.text: OneLake Catalog search API and MCP tool (Preview) brings cross-workspace discovery to code with a single search request to locate matching items across your accessible estate based on catalog metadata and user permissions, with the capability also included as a built-in tool in the Fabric Core MCP server for AI agents. The Fabric CLI fab find command extends the search to the terminal so you can locate items across workspaces, filter or exclude by item type, and pipe results through JMESPath. For more information, see OneLake catalog overview.
